title: Consume Dactyl v0.10.0 SQLite maintenance contract for Issue #1313
intent: Integrate Dactyl v0.10.0 native integrity verification, online backup, and explicit dump/reload recovery into Decapod's existing canonical local datastore boundary. Preserve typed health, unavailable/locked, corrupt/malformed, unsupported-capability, and recovery/rollback outcomes; require bounded cooperating-client coordination and writer quiescence; never auto-repair or expose raw SQLite behavior.
stop_conditions: Do not modify Dactyl or implement raw SQLite recovery/shell-outs.
Do not trigger backup or recovery during startup, validation, append, or connection creation.
Do not add multi-run/workspace orchestration or expose raw SQLite handles/PRAGMAs.
